faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about sparks, billing, and privacy protection.
faq.q1: What is satulabs.id and what features are available?
faq.a1: satulabs.id is a unified generative AI studio allowing you to create 4K commercial images, 60fps dynamic cinematic videos, and AI upscales from simple text prompts directly in your browser.
faq.a2: Register with your email, verify with a quick OTP, and select your initial sparks pack. Your balance is instantly activated for generating images and videos.
faq.q3: Is there any recurring monthly subscription fee?
faq.a3: None at all. We operate on a pure pay-as-you-go model. You only purchase sparks when you need them, without recurring card debits.
faq.a4: We support instant local payment options: QRIS (GoPay, OVO, Dana, LinkAja, ShopeePay), bank transfers / Virtual Accounts (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI), and e-wallets.
faq.a5: No. Purchased sparks remain securely in your account forever with zero expiration.
faq.a6: Your sparks are 100% protected. With Hold-Capture-Release, sparks are only deducted on successful completion. Any system issue triggers an automatic full refund.
faq.q7: Are my creations private or publicly displayed?
faq.a7: 100% private. All your generated images and videos remain in your private Library for 14 days and are accessible only by you.
